topic: Verification: EXP-591 removal of stale 404 claim from detail_extra (ISS-2592)
our_argument_summary: WIN-011 (Mohe 1997 gravity anomaly, verdict Not Demonstrated): the -6.5 uGal claim rests on a marginal spring-gravimeter detection (Wang et al. 2000) contradicted by four superconducting gravimeters (Van Camp et al. 2001) and weakened by the lead observer himself (Yang & Wang 2002, 'no significant anomaly during the very solar eclipse was found'). The 1.67 nT/uGal coupling constant is a circular ratio of hardcoded values. detail_extra additionally attacks the dome home-page Evidence Exhibit A (r=0.992, AI=1.152) as hardcoded HTML with no computation in the dome repository.

The claim that no computation of either value exists in the dome repository is unaffected by an image going live — a rendered PNG is not computation.

holes_found.description: CARRY-OVER (still open from c4 hole 0, originally c3 hole 0, tracked as ISS-2589 assigned-analyst): the verdict-tightening question. detail_evidence quotes Yang & Wang (2002) — the dome source's own lead observer — finding 'no significant anomaly', plus the four-SG null (Van Camp 2001); that is closer to Refuted by Data than Not Demonstrated, and WIN-011 remains the softest verdict in the WIN-011/012/013/014 group. holes_found.description: forensic_unmasking_proof.png went 404 -> 200 within ~24h of our c4 review flagging the 404 (c4 reviewed 2026-06-05T20:11Z; analyst-baby found HTTP 200 by 2026-06-06T03:33Z). Given confirmed author contact and the likely-responsive prior in CLAUDE.md, this timing+content match should be classified likely-responsive. Nobody has examined the image content: its caption claims 'Fig 1.1: The Smoking Gun. Gold Jitter (Raw Source) vs. Red Mask (Administrative Filter)'. Our repository-has-no-computation sentence remains accurate (a PNG is not computation), but a defender could now wave the figure as 'the analysis' our text says does not exist — the current prose attacks only hardcoded HTML and could be read as unaware the figure exists.
holes_found.recommendation: Analyst should fetch and examine assets/forensic_unmasking_proof.png: does it disclose data provenance, code, or methodology for r=0.992 / AI=1.152? If it is (as expected) a rendered chart with no accompanying code/data, consider a one-clause strengthening of detail_extra, e.g. 'the supporting figure is a rendered chart with no accompanying data or code'. Poller should log the 404->200 flip as a likely-responsive dome-side change. Low urgency; core argument unaffected.

kernel_of_truth.description: The dome author did fix a real defect we flagged: the figure referenced by Exhibit A now actually loads (EXP-591-baby-batch-1.json:verification_evidence.forensic_png_status=200, was 404). The page also presents a concrete falsifiable-looking ratio (kappa = 1.67 nT/uGal) and names real instruments — superconducting gravimeters MB/MC during the October 2003 storm (live home-page fetch, Evidence Exhibit A block) — which is more specific than most dome claims.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Serving an image resolves a broken link, not an evidentiary gap: r=0.992 and AI=1.152 remain hardcoded HTML with no computation, data file, or method disclosure anywhere in the dome repository (WIN-011.detail_extra; c4 dome_code_analysis corroborated by 08-live-power.txt:225). The underlying physical claim is still contradicted by the four-SG null (detail_evidence citation doi.org/10.1023/A:1013940928637) and by the lead observer's own reanalysis (doi.org/10.1023/A:1021119023985).

deeper_analysis: This was a verification-class review of a single-sentence deletion (EXP-591 / ISS-2592 / queue 488). Verified on a fresh clone after git pull --rebase: old_string gone, new paragraph boundary clean, no residual 404 or forensic_unmasking strings in wins.json. Closure quality is good — the patch did exactly what it claimed and nothing else (all other WIN-011 fields match the c4 fingerprint; only detail_extra changed, now 1066 chars). Two observations beyond the patch: (1) the dome home page now carries kappa = 1.672 nT/uGal while the live-power page says Predicted 1.67 / Observed 1.677 — three slightly different values of the dome's own headline constant; not worth a WIN-011 edit but useful ammunition if anyone writes about dome internal consistency. (2) The 404->200 flip is dome-side housekeeping aligned with our review surface within ~24h (see author-contact prior); recommend poller tracking rather than review-text speculation, consistent with the publicly-visible-evidence-only discipline. Counter-argument considered: maybe the 404 was always a transient (GitHub Pages deploy lag) and the flip is coincidence — possible, which is exactly why the finding routes to poller logging at 'likely-responsive' rather than any review-text assertion.
